cohort: All cases of omphalocele, including live births, stillbirths, and terminations of pregnancy, identified in Finnish registers between 1993 and 2014.
finding: Omphalocele is a rare congenital anomaly, frequently associated with other malformations; while isolated cases may be more common than previously thought and have reasonably good survival without chromosomal defects, over half of affected pregnancies are often terminated.
